300	### 10.2 — Agent-triggered upgrades ("tell Claude to upgrade")
301	
302	The backend container cannot call `docker` or `systemctl` directly. To let an
303	agent task trigger an upgrade, install the **upgrade webhook** — a tiny Python
304	HTTP server that runs on the *host* and listens only on the Docker bridge
305	interface (172.18.0.1), so it is unreachable from the public internet.
306	
307	**Install the webhook service:**
308	
309	```bash
310	# Install the service unit
311	sudo install -m 644 /opt/cronos/deploy/cronos-upgrade-webhook.service \
312	  /etc/systemd/system/
313	
314	# Make the upgrade script executable
315	chmod +x /opt/cronos/upgrade.sh
316	
317	# Allow the cronos user to run systemctl restart without a password prompt
318	# (needed because upgrade.sh calls `sudo systemctl restart cronos.service`)
319	echo 'cronos ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: /bin/systemctl restart cronos.service' \
320	  | sudo tee /etc/sudoers.d/cronos-upgrade
321	
322	sudo systemctl daemon-reload
